_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for the freshness subject -> producer mapping (AC7/AC8 of
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the evidence of the subjects below must stay within K delivery-face
commits of the develop tip (goal AC-214). Refreshing them is a real cross-machine PRODUCER
run, and before this file that mapping lived only in the prose of whichever one-off task was
closing the gap at the time. Cost, measured: the gap re-crossed 4 times in 5 days
(2026-09-13 x2, 2026-09-14 x2), each crossing closed by a manual re-run with no trigger.
WHO READS IT (one source, two readers -- never a second copy):
subject has no registered producer at all);
* plugin/probes/freshness-refresh.md -- the routine probe (which producer to name in a
finding, and each producer's wall clock for the threshold arithmetic).
`wallclock_hours` is a MEASURED quantity, not an estimate: it is the end-to-end wall clock of
one producer run observed on this repo, and it feeds the probe's threshold
THRESHOLD_fraction = (wallclock_hours + interval_hours) * rate_per_hour / K. A wrong value
here moves a threshold, so each entry records where its number came from.
_scope_note: A carrier record counts as a REFRESHABLE SUBJECT iff its `ac` matches subject_id_pattern AND it carries a top-level 40-hex build_sha. Measured on the real carrier 2026-09-14, that rule yields exactly the seven subjects below: GOAL-009-AC-204/206 match the pattern but carry no build_sha; GOAL-018-AC-257 carries a build_sha but not the GOAL-009 prefix.

producers._wallclock_measured: 20m36s end-to-end, measured on this repo (recorded in the AC-214 gap history; the coldstart face is the cheap half of the pair).

2h, from THREE converging sources, ⚠️ with the honest caveat that a full end-to-end measurement is currently BLOCKED (see below): (a) the AC-214 task text's own worked example ('升级面约 2h'); (b) the measured record in that same text — the coldstart face measured 20m36s end-to-end, and the upgrade face is recorded as 跨机小时级 (the AC-239 half alone drives a real defect fix + fan-in + a full suite); (c) the MECHANICAL bound the producer imposes on itself — verify-deliver-coldstart.sh's AC239_POLL_SECS default 3600s, i.e. the e2e is *declared* to finish within 1h and times out (writing no record) beyond it. ⛔ CAVEAT, stated because an unmeasured input to a threshold is exactly what this task forbids elsewhere: the full end-to-end wall clock could not be MEASURED on 2026-09-14 because the upgrade face's AC-239 half is structurally unreachable — the shipped artifact carries no dist/driver-anchor.js, so `quay driver start` returns rc=1 in every installed layout (reproduced fail-closed text in the task's Resolution). The three sources above therefore BOUND W from below/around; if the true value is larger, the threshold is too small and the probe files too late, so this entry must be re-measured once that defect is fixed. ⚠️ Conservative direction check: W only ever INCREASES the threshold, so an over-estimate files early (safe, mild noise) and an under-estimate files late (loses the window) — re-measure before trusting the margin.
